messages:
ReleaseCheckBot: release check FAILED for release v2026-03-18-canary
ReleaseCheckBot: reason: env parity mismatch detected: ConfigMap 'inference-flags' key 'enable_kv_cache' type=string in prod vs bool in staging
alice: saw this pop up in preflight, deploy blocked by policy
alice: can someone confirm which change introduced it?
bob: looked at git history, #412 changed default quoting in values.yaml, might have turned some booleans into quoted strings
carol: that PR updated chart templates to use Helm's `toJson` in one place, suspect it serialized values as strings for legacy flags
dave: prod was promoted using a direct `kubectl apply -f` path for the chart output (skipped templating step) last week, so prod got a different rendered type
eric: quick question — does runtime actually blow up on string vs bool? ParseBool should accept "true"...
carol: our config loader unmarshals with strict typing; when k8s API returns a string the YAML -> struct step fails: `yaml: unmarshal errors: cannot unmarshal string into bool`
frank: confirmed pods in prod are CrashLoopBackOff with that exact unmarshal error in logs
alice: change window closes in ~30m. What's the safest path: patch prod configmap or roll back the release?
devops: patching is possible but manual and risky during peak; also found a separate env var name mismatch (S3_CACHE_PREFIX_ vs S3_CACHE_PREFIX) between staging/prod that patching won't fix atomically
bob: agree, too many moving parts. Rolling back to the previous stable image seems safer for the short window
carol: +1 rollback. We should pin the image after rollback before reattempting the chart change
frank: image pin available for previous canary: `redwood/inference:sha256:beefcafe` — can rollback in ~5min
alice: impact assessment? any user-facing errors other than pod restarts?
frank: only internal batching jobs failing and increased latencies for some request paths; no customer-facing 5xxs observed yet, but risk rising
dave: also flagging that kubernetes secret `INFERENCE_KEY_PREFIX` has trailing slash in prod and not in staging; might cause cache keys to miss after any hand edits
carol: patching secrets + configmap in prod during a handoff is too risky. Rollback + fix chart + add checks is the plan
ReleaseCheckBot: suggested rollback command:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-frontend --to-revision=23
```
frank: starting rollback now
frank: rollback executed, rollout status shows `deployment "inference-frontend" successfully rolled out`
frank: health checks passing, replicas 6/6 and liveness checks stable
alice: thanks. Action items: PR to update chart template (no quoting for booleans), add helm unit test for types, add deploycheck rule to compare key types across envs
carol: I'll open the chart PR and add a unit test in `charts/inference/tests`
bob: I'll add a lint rule in deploy CI to fail when a bool is quoted in values.yaml
devops: I'll add a secondary deploycheck to compare k8s API types between staging and prod for the same ConfigMap keys
alice: created tickets: INF-789 (helm chart: enforce boolean types), INF-790 (deploycheck: type-compare rule)
frank: leaving monitoring on; will update if anything unusual shows up
alice: update release notes: rolled back canary due to env parity drift in configmap/secret typing, will reattempt after fixes
frank: noted, closing thread after observation window
alice: :thumbsup:
